item.title: RANDOM SHOTS: A look back at Laguindingan Airport, aerial view (May 2013)
item.description: Here’s a throwback aerial photo of Laguindingan Airport taken on May 30, 2013—less than three weeks before its official opening on June 15, 2013. Today, the airport is managed and operated by Aboitiz InfraCapital, Inc. (AIC), with expansion plans already in the pipeline. Read details of the airport expansion in our post below. item.title: RANDOM SHOTS: Lightning strike kills horse, injures rider in Bukidnon
item.description: In a tragic irony during the Year of the Horse, a horse was killed after being struck by lightning, while its rider was rushed to the hospital. The incident occurred at around 3:20 p.m. on January 2, 2026, in Purok 17, Hindangon, Barangay Poblacion, Valencia City, Bukidnon.
